capture_wrapper:
import json,subprocess,sys
command=[sys.executable,'tools/mapgyver/run-qualification.py','1','q02','--recreate','100','--samples','1','--nvidia-overlay','off']
result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=490)
e=json.loads(result.stdout)
if e['run'].get('report') is not None:
    r=e['run']['report']
    generations=r.pop('generations')
    r['generation_columns']=['generation','end','elapsed_seconds','setup_ms','consumer_ready_ms','native_output_extent','fixed_geometry_observed','sampled_geometry_mismatches','output_presents','preview_presents','spout_sends','retirement_fence_ms']
    r['generation_rows']=[[g[k] for k in r['generation_columns']] for g in generations]
    r['scene_columns']=['generation','elapsed_seconds','process_id','private_bytes','working_set_bytes','handle_count','live_bytes_by_owner','retiring_bytes_by_owner','live_textures','retiring_textures','peak_live_plus_retiring_bytes','peak_live_plus_retiring_textures','gpu_local_nonlocal']
    r['scene_rows']=[[g['generation'],g['steady_scene']['elapsed_seconds'],*[g['steady_scene']['process'][k] for k in ['process_id','private_bytes','working_set_bytes','handle_count']],*[g['steady_scene']['allocations'][k] for k in ['live_bytes_by_owner','retiring_bytes_by_owner','live_textures','retiring_textures','peak_live_plus_retiring_bytes','peak_live_plus_retiring_textures']],g['steady_scene']['gpu_local_nonlocal']] for g in generations]
    r['release_columns']=['generation','process_id','private_bytes','working_set_bytes','handle_count']
    r['release_rows']=[[g['generation'],*[g['after_release'][k] for k in r['release_columns'][1:]]] for g in generations]
    r['fenced_allocation_columns']=['generation','live_bytes_by_owner','retiring_bytes_by_owner','live_textures','retiring_textures','peak_live_plus_retiring_bytes','peak_live_plus_retiring_textures']
    r['fenced_allocation_rows']=[[g['generation'],*[g['allocations_after_fence'][k] for k in r['fenced_allocation_columns'][1:]]] for g in generations]
    r['consumer_columns']=['generation','phase','extent','elapsed_ms','sampled_bgra','sampled_alpha','sampled_generation_markers']
    r['consumer_rows']=[[g['generation'],*[g['consumer_checkpoint'][k] for k in r['consumer_columns'][1:]]] for g in generations if g['consumer_checkpoint'] is not None]
    r['final_settling']=generations[-1]['settling']
    observations=r['resources'].pop('gpu_observations')
    r['resources']['allocation_columns']=r['fenced_allocation_columns'][1:]
    r['resources']['allocation_rows']=[[o['renderer_allocations'][k] for k in r['resources']['allocation_columns']] for o in observations]
    e['retirement_archive_scope']='All generation geometry/checkpoints/release/fence/consumer observations and every periodic process/allocation row retained. Per-generation timing/cadence/operation distributions and raw DXGI presentation statistics omitted; this archive makes no frame-time/scanout/copy qualification claim.'
    baseline=generations[10]['steady_scene']['process']
    remaining=[g['steady_scene']['process'] for g in generations[10:]]+[generations[-1]['settling']['scene']['process']]
    e['retirement_assessment']={'baseline_generation':10,'baseline':baseline,'settled':generations[-1]['settling']['scene']['process'],'steady_handle_min_max':[min(p['handle_count'] for p in remaining),max(p['handle_count'] for p in remaining)],'max_steady_private_growth_bytes':max(p['private_bytes'] for p in remaining)-baseline['private_bytes'],'final_handle_delta':remaining[-1]['handle_count']-baseline['handle_count'],'shutdown_seconds':r['shutdown_seconds'],'all_fenced_allocations_zero':all(g['allocations_after_fence']['live_textures']==0 and g['allocations_after_fence']['retiring_textures']==0 for g in generations)}
print(json.dumps(e,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode)

assessment_scope.baseline: Generation 10 live-scene checkpoint; compare all later live-scene checkpoints plus final 10-second settled checkpoint. Same renderer/windows/sources/observer remain active.
assessment_scope.shutdown: Final GPU retirement through fixture/observer reaping, native event-loop return and worker join. Excludes report serialization, process exit and WebView subprocess termination.
limitations: Controlled device reconstruction subtest, not complete Q05/product lifecycle qualification.
Logical renderer allocations only; driver physical retirement and source/observer logical ownership totals remain unknown.
No frame-time, displayed cadence, queue-depth, frame-age or scanout pass inferred from this retirement-only archive.
